decisions.reason: As a declared flagship with repeated gold-medal recognition, the premium raisin stollen stands clearly above aspiration levels and is very unlikely to be withdrawn.
The seeded rye mixed bread fits the core assortment and existing production routines well, so after surviving the last review it likely meets at least acceptable aspiration levels and should stay.

The ancient grain bread remains the most uncertain and resource-demanding of the survivors, but its strategic fit with artisanal quality positioning and the absence of a clear failure signal still make continued trial more likely than withdrawal.
